test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Shivani purchased five pens for ₹600. She sells these five pens at the rate of ₹50 per pen. What is the approximate loss percentage that Shivani incurred on selling the five pens?
solution:
Given:

Shivani purchased five pens for ₹600

She sells these five pens at the rate of ₹50 per pen

Formula used:

Loss = CP - SP

Loss % = (Loss/CP) × 100</p
